title: JavaSMP
description: Your main goal on this server is to become the strongest by obtaining legendary weapons. One of the crafting materials for these weapons is a player's head, which you can acquire by killing other players; doing so also grants you an extra heart.
body: Your main goal on this server is to become **the strongest** by obtaining **legendary weapons**. One of the crafting materials for these weapons is a player's head, which you can acquire by killing other players; doing so also grants you an **extra heart**, whereas being killed by another player causes you to lose one.
